items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: You know, when I'd go to her house and she'd invite us to her home, and she would have just walls, just like your records are there.

ctx.x: She did. She started me collecting

records. I don't know if I even said that before, but if not I must say it now, because I credit her with really inspiring me to collect. You know, when I'd go to her house and she'd invite us to her home, and she would have just walls, just like your records are there. That was an idea that she had, only she had hers about four feet tall, Pat, all around the room. She had just like in a record shop. Like here, just like where your books are, that was nothing but records and albums. And she started me, she…

Well, I've talked to a lot of people who she inspired, and they say that when she was managing that May Company department store record department, it stocked all the good jazz there was, and it was the best place in town to go buy jazz was at the May Company. Now try and find jazz in the May Company.
